page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Centred title block from top to bottom; a printer's ornament and a device in the centre-lower part; library stamps at right and left (not transcribed).

main_text.l: Omnia in unum volumen redegit atque secundam hanc Editionem variis additamentis locupletiorem accuravit, nec non Graeca, quae Graeci minus gnaros tardare potuissent, Latinè vertit.

page.notes: Engraved or printed ornaments and a device appear between the lines; library stamps (Biblioteca Naz. Roma, Vittorio Emanuele) and a digitiser's watermark are not transcribed. The word "Graeca" is printed "Graca" and "dabit" is printed "dabic" in the scan; the rendering above uses the likely forms. Some letters are blurred under the stamps and device.
